name: Kyland Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyland Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides industrial internet solutions in China and internationally. The company offers industrial internet OS/cloud platform; industrial communication chips/bus chips; industrial ethernet solutions, including layer 3 backbone, rackmount, DIN rail, EN50155, un-managed, TSN, HSR/PRP, and PoE ethernet switches, as well as multi-function switching platforms, optical fiber converters, industrial ethernet modules, network management software, SFP modules, and accessories; time servers; industrial, traffic, and power servers; serial device servers and intelligent gateways; smart city; and energy internet products.
